objective: Evaluate the fixed direct-aperture hydrogen release and source-depletion model on an untouched 80 K campaign from the public PRESLHY E3.1 archive.

source.campaign: PRESLHY E3.1 Part A, 80 K D4 release package
source.license: CC BY 4.0 as declared by the public record
source.rights_boundary: The package is read from the public source cache for evaluation. Raw measurement arrays are not copied into the repository; only aggregate metrics and hashes are retained.

frozen_model.source_depletion: real-gas CascadeBank inventory with measured initial pressure and measured initial source temperature
frozen_model.ambient_boundary: measured workbook ambient pressure when available; otherwise ineligible
frozen_model.time_window: post-opening trace until the pressure reaches 1.05 times measured ambient pressure
frozen_model.integration: LSODA, rtol 1e-7, fixed bounded max_step from the existing evaluator

aggregate_decision.negative_result_policy: A failed result remains archived and cannot be replaced by a tuned parameter or a changed case selection.

claim_boundary: A pass supports only a bounded 80 K direct-aperture source-depletion component claim for the public E3.1 D4 campaign. It does not validate cryogenic two-phase flow, ignition, dispersion, flame radiation, station control, refuelling, or emergency separation distance.
